home.collectionsSubtitle: Selected works from the Woodist studio
home.aboutBody: Woodist is a furniture studio based in Girne, North Cyprus. Every piece is built by hand from solid, responsibly sourced timber — designed to live with you for decades, not seasons.
home.projectsSubtitle: Custom commissions for homes, offices and hospitality spaces
home.ctaBody: Tell us about your space — a single piece, a full interior, or a commercial fit-out.

projects.title: Individual Projects

projects.ctaBody: Whether it's a single statement piece or a full interior, we'd love to hear what you're imagining. Book a call or send us the details — we'll come back with thoughts within two working days.
